flagged.title: Complicated Love
flagged.reason: The video states that 'bamboozled' and 'maroonded' are comic rhymes (F14), which is textually inaccurate as they do not rhyme, leading students to make false textual claims in AO2 analysis and be marked wrong on lesson assessments.

mark_affecting.quote: He throws in these comic, nonsense rhymes like bamboozled and maroonded specifically to deflate the whole grandeur of Paris.

flagged.title: Comparison Skills
flagged.reason: The video instructs students to write a single 40-mark essay comparing a named anthology poem to a memorised anthology poem, failing to teach the actual exam format (Part a: 20-mark comparison with an unseen poem; Part b: separate 20-mark question on an anthology poem of choice), which would cause students to write the wrong essay and lose substantial marks.

mark_affecting.quote: In the exam, they give you one named poem and then you have to pull a second one entirely from memory... Because this single comparison essay is worth a massive 40 marks
